name: Default AoE Hitter
dsl: ?(deck.remaining >= 2) any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage & aoe>) & any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage & aoe>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) | ?(self.health < 30%) any<heal> @ self | ?(self.beneficial_wards == 0) any<ward> @ self | "Feint Mass - Amulet" | any<blade & stacks>[sharp] @ self | ?(self.beneficial_auras == 0) any<aura & out_damage> | any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>] | any<blade>[sharp] @ self | pass
description: Heals itself below 30% health and shields itself when it has no shield. Casts stacking buffs before it attacks (Mass Feint, a blade on itself, an aura), then hits with AoE. Only casts a non-stacking blade when it doesn't have enough pips to attack.
